maya: Hey — running into a weird hang in the sampleapp when our circuit-breaker trips. Requests pile up and never complete on Android 13/14.

jake: Can you paste the dispatcher stats / logs?

maya: pasted below — you can see queued calls keep growing after auth refresh.

maya: ```
OkHttp Dispatcher: running=2, queued=37, maxRequests=64, maxRequestsPerHost=5
W/System.err: java.lang.IllegalStateException: callback on main thread
 at okhttp3.internal.concurrent.TaskRunner.execute(TaskRunner.kt:...)
 at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealCall.getResponseWithInterceptorChain(RealCall.kt:...)
```

olivia: That stacktrace smells like we're doing a synchronous token refresh that touches the OkHttp client from the main thread (Authenticator or Interceptor).

maya: Here's our Authenticator (simplified):

maya: ```kotlin
class TokenAuthenticator : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    // synchronous refresh on current thread
    val newToken = authClient.refreshToken() // this uses Retrofit/OkHttp under the hood
    return response.request.newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $newToken").build()
  }
}
```

sam: Yep — calling the same client inside authenticate can deadlock the dispatcher if all threads are blocked waiting for auth. On Android this often manifests as main-thread complaints when your app's executor is starved.

jake: Quick repro checklist:
  • Run sampleapp with okhttp dispatcher default
  • Force token expiry + enable circuit-breaker so many calls run concurrently
  • Observe queued growing and then ANR-ish behavior

maya: Workaround I tested: async refresh that uses a separate short-lived OkHttpClient (no shared dispatcher) and returns the token via synchronized cache, then retry. That stopped the queue growth.

olivia: We should update onboarding docs and sampleapp to show a safe pattern. Also add a lint note: never call the same client synchronously inside Authenticator.

jake: Can someone open a tiny PR to change sampleapp Authenticator to use a token provider (non blocking) and add a comment with the link to this thread?

ci-bot: Created issue #4321: "authenticator deadlock with shared OkHttpClient on Android" — https://git.internal/redwood/issues/4321 :robot_face:

maya: Pushed a local branch with the workaround and a test, link: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/compare/fix/auth-deadlock (manual for now)

sam: I'll take the PR and add a unit test for dispatcher starvation. Also schedule a short devex note in onboarding checklist.

olivia: Adding to the devex backlog and will drop a small blurb in the SDK migration guide (v0.12.x -> v0.13.0) about Authenticator patterns.

maya: Thanks — leaving this thread for now, will post updates after PR lands. :thumbsup:
